baseline_assertion: For precommit failures, canonical entities/revisions/annotations/asset registrations equal pre-request state after rollback and reopen; no published partial query generation.

cases.expect: Reject unsupported version before writes; list supported versions; no automatic migration
Reject at epoch cell_id path; no partial source/cell/epoch rows
Reject duplicate identity; also enforce native concurrent uniqueness in separate two-writer test
Reject string where declared number before commit; no implicit conversion
Reject malformed unit; separately test field-registry dimension/unit conflicts without pretending JSON proves scientific units
Reject present null; zero/false and explicit statuses retain meaning
Reject asserted verification; supplied locators cause no fetch/copy/open/QC pass
Reject wrong derivation; separately test same UUID changed source/ancestry and JSON checksum substituted as H5 Source identity
Reject stale payload/generation token after revalidation under lock; no partial records

cases.input: future multi-entity fixture with late invalid row or audit failure
cases.expect: All canonical writes roll back; no asset bindings or success receipts leak

cases.input: future explicit attach fixture with owned staging
cases.expect: Crash recovery removes or quarantines unpublished owned staging; no leaked registrations; never deletes pre-existing/shared assets

cases.input: future valid import with publication fault
cases.expect: Canonical commit remains recorded; index is unpublished/rebuild-needed; correct fallback or explicit incomplete; no false rollback claim

cases.input: expected/bundle.json twice and changed content under same revision
cases.expect: Exact replay idempotent; same revision/different content rejected; r2 requires approved expected prior revision

transaction_requirements: Canonical DataJoint writes share one connection and transaction; filesystem and SQLite publication are separate observed stages.
Any statement failure aborts the entire import transaction, even if InnoDB rolled back only that statement.
skip_duplicates cannot prove payload equality; compare exact replay/revision content explicitly.
ignore_extra_fields cannot satisfy losslessness; unknown fields require reviewed preservation/query mapping or rejection.
